title: "License"

The programs and components of the ADFR software suite are distributed under the [Sannerlab MIT-like Source-Available License](/software/license.qmd), the
license of all the lab's software.

The **MSMS** program and the **MSLIB** component, which compute molecular surfaces, are covered
by this license for non-commercial use only; commercial use needs a separate license. Of the
suite's programs, only `agfrgui` uses them, for surface calculation and display. They are not used
by `adfr`, `agfr`, `autosite`, `adcp`, `prepare_ligand` or `prepare_receptor`.

For a commercial license for MSMS and MSLIB, contact [Dr. Michel Sanner](mailto:sanner@scripps.edu).
